_how: The founder's own slots. Everything here stays hidden on the site until it's filled in. Event ids are the ids in data/events/events.json (the last part of an event page's address: /events/<id>/). Route ids: data/picks/picks.json. Place ids: data/favourites/favourites.json (the last part of /favourites/<id>/). Rebuild the pages (node scripts/make-pages.mjs) after editing.

myPick._how: The event I'd go to this month: shows as a card on the home page and at the top of the newsletter. event = an event id; line = one line in my words; photo = an image address (optional); video = a YouTube or Instagram address (optional).

preparing._how: What I'm preparing for now: pinned at the top of the Blog and on the home page. event = an event id; line = one line in my words; side = a side project line (optional); updates = newest first: {"date": "2026-10-31", "line": "", "photo": "", "video": ""}.
preparing.line: Every year on the start line I look back on the year of preparation and realise I've already had my fun. The year is the living. The run is the report card: 60 seconds, in my case. And I'm finding out more about myself in the preparation than in the execution.
preparing.side: The widebody is becoming a rally car. The work's done and I've driven it. Hopefully the side gig becomes the bigger gig.

lastEvent._how: My last event and what it taught me: shows under Preparing for on the Blog. name = the event; date = when; reflection = a few lines in my words; photo = an image address (optional). Stays hidden until reflection is filled. more = extra photo addresses (optional); video = a short .mp4 on the site (optional), poster = its still image.
lastEvent.name: Killarney Time Attack
lastEvent.reflection:
Massive prep. Four test drives. Then a massive spin on turn two, the fastest incident yet. After the week motorsport had, I can't say it wasn't on my mind.
I quickly became a passenger, watching to see where it was going to end. Momentum is your friend. Until it's not.
Packed up, went home, and slept for four days. Almost.
No amount of preparation is ever enough. It's a lifestyle. And a road test and a track test are not the same thing.

myTake._how: My line on events I know: shows on that event's page under My take. One entry per event, like "simola-hillclimb-2027": "one line".

_top5how: My top 5 lists: each becomes a page under High Octane, My top 5. Add one like {"id": "hill-climbs", "title": "Top 5 hill climbs worth the trip", "intro": "one or two lines", "items": [{"event": "simola-hillclimb-2027", "line": "why"}, {"route": "swartberg-loop", "line": "why"}, {"place": "franschhoek-motor-museum", "line": "why"}]}. id = the page address, lower case with dashes.

autodidact._how: The Autodidact page (Blog, Autodidact). intro = a short paragraph; entries = builds and the cars I road-trip, newest first: {"title": "", "date": "2026-10-31", "line": "", "photo": "", "link": ""}.
autodidact.intro: Ducati taught me the road. KTM taught me off-road. Now I live on a farm and yearn for the safari life, so everything in the shed is being made to safari.

_tourshow: My annual petrolhead tours and Wild Goose Chase rounds, as dated events in FOMO (Remind me and Take me there work on them). Add one like {"id": "wild-goose-chase-round-1-2027", "name": "Wild Goose Chase, round 1", "start": "2027-03-06", "end": "2027-03-07", "venue": "", "city": "", "country": "South Africa", "lat": -33.9, "lon": 18.6, "url": "https://onetrackmind.online/...", "line": "one line"}. Then run node scripts/merge-events.mjs.

mates._how: Mates: people and places I rate (the page /about/mates/). Add entries to the groups below. Each one: {"name": "", "url": "https://...", "line": "one line in my words", "logo": "/img/mates/name.png" (optional), "top": 1 to 5 (optional: my top 5 in that group, 1 = best), "poi": "a place id from data/favourites/favourites.json" (optional: links to its page with Take me there), "sponsored": true (only if they pay)}. The page, the About menu item and the footer line stay hidden until there are 5 entries in total. Each group's top 5 also becomes a My top 5 list.
